method: 40 mm measured-point sampling. Ground RANSAC plus robust slope fit. Single least-squares tree plane Y=aX+bZ+c through ALL observed returns 0.30–4.50 m above ground. Acute angle between plane sections at median along-row X; not the full 3D dihedral.
limitations: Statistical observed-point plane, not a verified biological centre plane.
Raw single-view visibility and different fields of view prevent using raw/final angle differences alone as registration error.
Geographic east/west inferred independently per dataset from H5 longitude.
No registered transforms applied to raw scans; only original IMU leveling. Horizontal row axes from low-stem/support candidates; flagged horizontal canopy PCA fallback if insufficient resolved stems.
The excluded duplicate and no-IMU capture are listed rather than assigned invented angles.
